title: Pre-release TT-X68-NEW-T47 package quotation

Earlier posts in the same thread describe the new X68 replacement as T47/UDH/32C, while size range, clearance, and availability were still provisional. The quote gives no size, destination, taxes, payment or purchase confirmation, and does not prove equivalence to the finalized 32C variant or current mainland CNY pricing. Community report, not an invoice, completed owner transaction, or manufacturer listing.
